answer: A concrete defense is the superlinear identity bond. Each new identity entering the registry, the garden, locks collateral, and the bond for the Nth identity from one operator scales as N squared: 1 identity costs 1 unit, but 1,000 sybils cost about 1,000,000 units. A per-epoch liveness beacon makes every bonded identity sign a fresh challenge; miss it and its reputation points, called embers, decay to zero and the stake is slashed. To break this an attacker must pay the quadratic collateral for every fake identity and keep them answering the beacon, so cost grows faster than any sybil reward.
